The '''Attack on ''SkyWind III''''' occurred during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] targeted [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] and [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] to gain an advantage over the Republic. In a surprise attack the Separatist [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] ''[[Starshot]]'' disabled the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] diplomatic vessel ''[[SkyWind III]]''. The Separatists boarded the ship with [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], hoping to capture [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Lerron]], one of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] accomplished diplomats.
